headline: White House Delays Hearing on Fed Governor Lisa Cook
summary: The administration postponed a hearing for Federal Reserve Governor Lisa D. Cook, whom President Trump has attempted to fire, after her lawyers cited scheduling issues.
why: Federal Reserve governors play a critical role in setting U.S. monetary policy, and leadership disputes or legal battles involving the central bank are closely watched by financial markets.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: The White House delayed a confirmation or oversight hearing regarding a Federal Reserve governor.
